svg.title: The second derivative of a parametric curve divides by dx/dt again
svg.desc: The unit circle x = cos t, y = sin t traced counterclockwise, its upper half in blue labelled concave down and its lower half in vermillion labelled concave up. Beside it: dy/dx = -cot t; d/dt of dy/dx = csc squared t, positive for every t; dividing by dx/dt = -sin t gives d2y/dx2 = -1 over sin cubed t, negative on the upper half and positive on the lower half. Skipping the division by dx/dt would call the whole circle concave up.

text.tspan: d/dt (dy/dx) = csc² t (positive for every t)
Skipping the division by dx/dt would call the whole circle concave up.
